title: VNC Remote Secure configuration
description: Intentionally partial schema covering the most commonly validated runtime variables. additionalProperties is true; see .env.example for the full list.

ALERT_SMTP_SERVER.description: SMTP server host for alert emails.

ALERT_SMTP_TLS.description: Attempt STARTTLS for alert emails (protects the message body, not only credentials).

ALERT_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_HTTP.description: Allow http:// webhook URLs (SSRF protection is HTTPS-only by default). Use only for LAN receivers.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE.description: Allow webhook URLs that resolve to private/loopback/link-local addresses. Use only for LAN receivers.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: HMAC secret for signing outbound webhook alerts (X-VncRemote-Signature header).

ALLOWED_LAN_IPS.description: Comma-separated list of LAN IPs allowed to access the services.

ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins.

AUDIO_BACKEND_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol nginx uses to reach the audio backend (auto-detected when unset).

AUDIO_STREAM_HOST.description: Bind address for the audio stream server.

AUDIO_STREAM_PORT.description: Port the audio stream server listens on.

AUDIT_LOG_FILE.description: Path to the audit log file (consumed by security/audit.py). Defaults to the platform log dir.

AUDIT_LOG_MAX_BYTES.description: Audit log rotation threshold in bytes (default 10485760).

AUDIT_MIRROR_FILE.description: Optional second append-only audit sink (e.g. a mounted network share or WORM store) so tampering with the primary log leaves the mirror intact.

AUDIT_STRICT.description: Fail-closed auditing: abort the audited action when its record cannot be persisted (default off — failures alert instead).

AUDIT_SYSLOG_HOST.description: Syslog collector for audit export (RFC 5424). Empty = disabled. The syslog MSG carries the exact JSON line written locally, chain hash included.

AUDIT_EXPORT_WEBHOOK.description: HTTPS endpoint that receives each persisted audit entry as JSON. Delivered via the DNS-pinned, redirect-refusing alert transport. Empty = disabled.

MAINTENANCE_MODE.description: Block new non-admin sessions (share links and logins) while keeping operator/env-admin access and existing sessions. Also toggled at runtime via 'vnc-remote maintenance on|off' (flag file).

WEBAUTHN_ENABLED.description: Enable WebAuthn/passkey registration and login ceremonies (requires the 'webauthn' package — pip install vnc-remote-secure[webauthn]). Default off.

WEBAUTHN_RP_ID.description: Relying Party ID for WebAuthn ceremonies (default: the request host). Must match the origin's registrable domain.

WEBAUTHN_RP_NAME.description: Relying Party display name shown by authenticators (default: 'VNC Remote Secure').

WEBAUTHN_USER_VERIFICATION.description: User-verification requirement for WebAuthn ceremonies (default 'preferred'). 'required' is mandatory for profiles enforcing user_verified auth policies.

AUDIT_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Dedicated Bearer token for /audit and /audit/verify. When set, HEALTH_AUTH_TOKEN no longer reaches the audit endpoints (credential separation for scrapers vs auditors).

METRICS_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Dedicated Bearer token for /metrics. When set, HEALTH_AUTH_TOKEN no longer reaches /metrics.

WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN.description: Expected origin for WebAuthn verification (default: request.url_root). Set explicitly when behind a reverse proxy that rewrites Host/scheme.

AUTH_LOCKOUT_SECONDS.description: Base lockout duration in seconds after too many attempts (escalates on repeat lockouts).

AUTH_LOCKOUT_ESCALATION.description: Progressive lockout: each consecutive lockout doubles the duration up to AUTH_LOCKOUT_MAX_SECONDS. Default true.

AUTH_LOCKOUT_MAX_SECONDS.description: Cap for progressive lockout escalation (default 86400 = 24 h).

AUTO_RESTART.description: Whether services are automatically restarted on failure.

BACKEND_BIND_HOST.description: Bind address for internal backend services.

BACKUP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT.description: Explicit opt-out allowing unencrypted backups under hardened security profiles. Backups contain .env, TLS private keys and the auth signing secret — prefer BACKUP_PASSWORD.

BACKUP_PASSWORD.description: When set, backups are Fernet-encrypted (.enc.tar.gz) and restore decrypts automatically. Required under hardened profiles unless BACKUP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT is set.

RFB_MAX_CLIPBOARD.description: Maximum bytes for a single ClientCutText clipboard message (default 1 MiB) — oversized payloads are dropped to bound server memory and limit the exfil channel.

RESTORE_KEEP_SESSIONS.description: Keep the ephemeral session store when restoring a backup (default off — restored share links are expired to avoid resurrecting sessions revoked after the backup).

BIND_HOST.description: Default bind address for public-facing services.

DISABLE_SSL.description: Disable SSL flag (set automatically by the script).

DISCORD_ENABLED.description: Whether Discord webhook notifications are enabled.

DUCK_DOMAIN.description: DuckDNS domain used for dynamic DNS.

DUCKDNS_TOKEN.description: DuckDNS API token for dynamic DNS updates.

EMAIL.description: Email address used for certificate registration.

FAIL2BAN_ENABLED.description: Whether fail2ban intrusion prevention is enabled (Linux).

FAIL2BAN_MAX_RETRY.description: Maximum failures before fail2ban bans an IP.

FLASK_SECRET_KEY.description: Secret key for Flask session signing.

GAMEPAD_BACKEND_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol nginx uses to reach the gamepad backend (auto-detected when unset).

GAMEPAD_HOST.description: Bind address for the gamepad server.

GAMEPAD_PORT.description: Port the gamepad server listens on.

HEALTHCHECK_ENABLED.description: Whether the periodic health check and auto-restart loop drives the Python service-manager watchdog.

HEALTHCHECK_INTERVAL.description: Interval in seconds between health checks.

HEALTH_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for health endpoints. Empty is allowed only on loopback binds; any non-loopback bind (USER_UI_HOST/HEALTH_WEB_HOST/BIND_HOST) fails closed without it.

HEALTH_BACKEND_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol used to reach backend services for health checks.

HEALTH_WEB_ENABLED.description: Whether the health web server is enabled.

HEALTH_WEB_HOST.description: Bind address for the health web server.

HEALTH_WEB_PORT.description: Port the health check web server listens on.

KEEP_TEMP_USER.description: Whether to keep the temporary user after the session ends.

LANDING_BACKEND_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol nginx uses to reach the landing backend (auto-detected when unset).

LANDING_HOST.description: Bind address for the landing page server.

LANDING_PASSWORD.description: Basic-auth password for the landing page. When empty a strong random value is generated and persisted to generated_credentials.env (the portal is fail-closed).

LANDING_PORT.description: Port the landing page server listens on.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level consumed by the Python runtime (core/logging.py).

MFA_REQUIRED.description: Whether MFA (TOTP) is required for user login.

NGINX_ENABLED.description: Whether nginx reverse proxy is enabled.

NGINX_HTTPS_PORT.description: Port nginx listens on for HTTPS.

NGINX_HTTP_PORT.description: Port nginx listens on for HTTP.

NOVNC_BACKEND_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol nginx uses to reach the noVNC backend (auto-detected when unset).

NOVNC_DIR.description: Directory containing the noVNC web assets (default <project>/novnc).

NOVNC_PORT.description: Port the noVNC web client listens on.

NOVNC_WS_PORT.description: Loopback-only websockify bridge port (WebSocket->RFB). Proxied by the noVNC server after auth.

PUBLIC_BIND_HOST.description: Public-facing bind address set by hardened profiles (overrides BIND_HOST for exposed services).

PYTHON.description: Python interpreter name/path used when registering the Windows service (optional tooling override).

RECOVERY_CODES_HASHES.description: JSON array of hashed recovery codes.

SECURITY_PROFILE.description: Security profile controlling bind addresses and hardening. Canonical names are development, trusted-lan, private-overlay, public-hardened; the others are legacy aliases accepted by `vnc-remote config migrate`.

SERVE_NOVNC_HOST.description: Bind address for the noVNC proxy (canonical; NOVNC_HOST is a legacy fallback).

SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE.description: Whether the session cookie requires HTTPS.

SESSION_IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Session idle timeout in seconds (used by the session cookie and Flask UI).

WEB_MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH.description: Maximum request body size in bytes accepted by the Flask user-management UI (mitigates memory-DoS via oversized POSTs).

EPHEMERAL_REQUIRE_RESOURCE.description: Require --resource binding on new ephemeral sessions — an unbound token reaches every resource its permissions allow.

SESSION_SAMESITE.description: SameSite attribute for the session cookie.

SHARED_STATE_BACKEND.description: Backend for cross-process shared state (rate limits, revocation markers, audit chain). 'sqlite' is the platform default (set via config/defaults/common.env) and enables cross-process sharing on a single host; 'memory' is process-local and intended for explicit single-process/test usage.

SHARED_STATE_DB_PATH.description: Filesystem path for the SQLite shared-state database when SHARED_STATE_BACKEND=sqlite. Defaults to <run_dir>/shared_state.db.

SHARED_STATE_STRICT.description: Fail-closed shared state: refuse startup when the sqlite backend cannot initialise (instead of the in-memory fallback) and deny sessions when revocation checks cannot consult the backend.

SSL_CERT.description: Path to the SSL certificate file.

SSL_KEY.description: Path to the SSL private key file.

TEMP_USER.description: Name of the temporary runtime user.

TEMP_USER_PASS.description: Password for the temporary runtime user.

TLS_ENABLED.description: Enable TLS for the current session.

TRUSTED_PROXY_IPS.description: Comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges allowed to set X-Forwarded-* headers when TRUSTED_PROXY=true (loopback always allowed).

TRUSTED_PROXY.description: Whether to trust X-Forwarded-* headers from a reverse proxy.

TTYD_BACKEND_PROTOCOL.description: Protocol nginx uses to reach the terminal backend (auto-detected when unset).

TERMINAL_BASIC_AUTH.description: Allow the legacy TTYD_* Basic-auth credential surface on the web terminal (default true). Set false to accept only token credentials (ephemeral cookie, bearer, operator session).

TERMINAL_IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds of terminal inactivity before the WebSocket is closed (default 900; 0 disables). Activity counts client input and server output.

TERMINAL_MSG_RATE.description: Maximum terminal WebSocket messages per second before the connection is closed (default 30; 0 disables).

WS_MAX_CONNECTIONS.description: Per-process cap on registered WebSocket connections (default 256) — bounds fd/thread exhaustion from connection floods.

WS_MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_IP.description: Cap on registered WebSocket connections per source IP (default 32) — one address must not own the whole connection budget.

TTYD_HOST.description: Bind address for the web terminal (ttyd on Linux, Tornado on Windows).

TTYD_PASSWD.description: Password for the web terminal (ttyd on Linux, Tornado on Windows). If not set, a random one is generated at startup (see .env.example).

TTYD_PORT.description: Port the web terminal listens on (ttyd on Linux, Tornado on Windows).

TTYD_USERNAME.description: Username for the web terminal (ttyd on Linux, Tornado on Windows). Leave empty to use the OS default (see .env.example).

ULTRAVNC_PATH.description: Path to the UltraVNC winvnc.exe binary (Windows only). Leave unset to auto-detect from common install locations.

ULTRAVNC_URL.description: Override URL for the UltraVNC portable archive downloaded by 'vnc-remote install' on Windows. Leave unset to use the official default.

USER_UI_ENABLED.description: Whether the user management UI is enabled.

USER_UI_HOST.description: Bind address for the user management UI.

USER_UI_PASSWORD.description: Password for the user management UI.

USER_UI_PORT.description: Port the user management UI listens on.

USER_UI_USERNAME.description: Username for the user management UI (default: TTYD_USERNAME if set, else the current user on Linux or admin on Windows).

VNC_HTTP_PORT.description: Port the VNC HTTP server listens on (UltraVNC).

VNC_PORT.description: Port the VNC server listens on.

VNC_REMOTE_PROFILE.description: Legacy alias for SECURITY_PROFILE (accepted by config migration).

WEBTERM_SHELL.description: Shell executable used by the web terminal.

WEBTERM_USER.description: Linux account terminal commands run as (privilege separation via setpriv/runuser; requires root).

TERMINAL_COMMAND_ALLOWLIST.description: Comma-separated regexes; when set, only matching commands may run in the web terminal (defense-in-depth when privilege drop is unavailable).

TERMINAL_WINDOWS_SANDBOX.description: Windows terminal sandbox: AppContainer isolation for spawned shells (auto=fallback on failure, strict=fail closed, off=disabled).

TERMINAL_WINDOWS_SANDBOX_DIRS.description: Semicolon-separated directories granted read access to sandboxed terminal commands on Windows.
